scene_summary: A flat, saturated yellow backdrop meets a pixelated green grass plane at roughly two-thirds height. At left, a lavender cube-like seat stands on four wobbly, pale pink tube legs; its top edge drops in five stair-stepped notches from a tall back-left corner down to the right. Behind it, a large blurred purple silhouette of a seated figure in a chin-on-hand Thinker pose fades into the yellow, and a small soft white cloud floats low at the right.
usable_surfaces: stair-stepped lavender top edge of the seat
flat lavender front face of the seat

detected_objects.label: Jagged stair-stepped top edge of the empty lavender cube seat
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The lavender block's upper contour is clearly visible as a sharp staircase of right-angle notches. It runs from the tall back-left corner (about x 0.18-0.27, y 0.46) and steps down five times to the right edge near x 0.39, y 0.57. It reads as a voxel- or mesh-like broken edge against the yellow background.
